adoption: Narrow automatic sampling policy implemented on branch; no installation or release

functional_initial.image_scope: lifecycle only; not image answer quality

host_observations.failure_count_semantics: Monitor failures are cumulative per worker session; report each session once and the maximum, never sum per-request snapshots.
host_observations.policy: all requests retained; monitor and paging observations are descriptive and never gate/exclude

performance.interpretation_limit: This is a cross-build AUTO-policy comparison with verified MTP depths, not an isolated draft-depth effect. Heldout session halves must both improve and their paired medians must differ by no more than 10 percentage points; otherwise report inconclusive. The endpoint is a bounded confirmation, not a general performance claim.
performance.request_record_policy: Contains only build/cell/session identifiers, counts, timings, sampling/MTP counters, host metrics and SHA-256 hashes. Session readiness objects, input/output token IDs and text are excluded.

publication_metadata_revision.reason: Name the completed performance continuation separately from its zero-worker metadata preflight
